questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

To enable women to become literate and provide for themselves, education for girls must be **__done voluntarily__**.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"****made mandatory."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"done voluntarily"** means that a particular action or activity is carried out willingly, by choice, or without any external compulsion or coercion. (कोई विशेष कार्य या गतिविधि स्वेच्छा से, पसंद से, या बिना किसी बाहरी दबाव या दबाव के की जाती है)
 
• When something is done voluntarily, it indicates that the individual involved has chosen to do it of their own accord, without being forced or obligated.
 
• It implies a sense of free will and a decision made without external pressure or influence.
 
• So, the phrase** "done voluntarily" **must be replaced with** "made mandatory."**
 
• **"Made mandatory"** refers to the imposition of a requirement or obligation, making a particular action or behavior obligatory or compulsory. (किसी आवश्यकता या दायित्व को थोपना, किसी विशेष कार्य या व्यवहार को अनिवार्य या अनिवार्य बनाना)
 
• When something is made mandatory, it means that individuals are required to comply with a rule, regulation, or directive, and failure to do so may result in consequences or penalties. 
 
• 
 
Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Their plan **__to action during that__** critical situation was well appreciated by all.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"of action during that."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the usage of the word **"to."**
 
• Using **"to"** in this context would suggest a different relationship between** "plan"** and **"action."**
 
• It might imply that the plan is directed toward the action or that the action is the purpose of the plan, which may not accurately convey the intended meaning.
 
• In the phrase **"plan of action," "of"** is used to indicate possession or association.
 
• In this context, **"of"** connects the noun **"plan"** with the noun** "action"** and shows that the action is associated with or belongs to the plan. 
 
• 
 
Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Their plan **of action during that**__ critical situation was well appreciated by all.*

• The error in the sentence is a subject-verb agreement issue.
 
• In this correction,** "has"** is changed to **"have"** to match the plural subject **"syllabus designers."**
 
• The verb **"have" **agrees with a plural subject, while **"has"** is used with a singular subject.
 
• 
 
Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: *The syllabus designers **have tried to address**__ the problem of time available for teaching.*
